description: Automotive and outdoor gear brand selling vehicle accessories and off-road gear through its own website; its affiliate program explicitly invites review sites, online communities, bloggers and other content creators to earn commission on referred sales.

evidence.summary: WOLFBOX's own affiliate page invites review sites, online communities, bloggers and content creators to join free of charge, advertises 'up to 12%' commission per successful referral, a 30-day cookie, and payouts through impact.com once the balance reaches $10. Because 12% is published only as a ceiling ('up to'), no single base rate is recorded.
The page publishes affiliate@wolfbox.com for affiliate questions and eligibility checks.
No earnings-cap statement appears anywhere on the fetched program page, so commission_cap is recorded as unknown; the 'up to 12%' figure is a rate ceiling, not a cap statement.

name: WOLFBOX

reasons.compensation: A commission ceiling of up to 12% is published on the brand's own page, but no base rate is stated, so the recorded rate stays null and compensation scores mid-range.
reasons.contact_access: A dedicated affiliate email (affiliate@wolfbox.com) is published on the program page for questions and eligibility.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC gear brand with a detailed, transparent program page (cookie, payout threshold and prohibited methods all published).
reasons.niche_fit: Vehicle tech and off-road gear is a proven review and demo niche for tech creators, and the program is pitched directly at review sites and creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open, free signup through the program page and Impact; no follower minimum is stated.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand's own program page recruits content creators and bloggers by name, but no creator counts or campaign examples are published.

description: Robot vacuum brand selling slim, app- and voice-connected robot vacuums and mops aimed at pet hair and hard floors, through its own site, Amazon and a heavily creator-driven TikTok Shop storefront (Lefant US).

evidence.summary: Rateful's TikTok Shop analysis (30 days to Nov 3, 2026) reports about 70% of Lefant US's estimated TikTok Shop sales came through affiliate creators' videos and LIVEs, and that creators with TikTok Shop affiliate access can add Lefant products to their showcase and earn commission on every sale — the brand qualifies through its TikTok Shop affiliate program. No commission rate is published there, so the rate is null.

Lasso lists a Lefant affiliate offer of up to 7.5% per sale, but that route runs through Amazon marketplace sales rather than a brand-run program and does not publish the TikTok Shop rate, so no rate is recorded.

opportunity.title: Lefant US TikTok Shop Affiliate Program

reasons.compensation: Commission exists on every affiliate sale but the rate is set per product inside TikTok Shop and is not published, so the recorded rate is null.
reasons.contact_access: No brand email or partnership page was found; the only route is inside TikTok Shop's affiliate center.
reasons.credibility: Sales figures are third-party Rateful estimates rather than brand-published data, so credibility is held down.
reasons.niche_fit: Robot vacuums are a top demo-driven home-tech category on TikTok, and Lefant's pet-hair positioning fits creator content well.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open collaboration — any creator with TikTok Shop affiliate access can add the products and start posting.
reasons.ugc_evidence: About 70% of the brand's TikTok Shop sales are reported to flow through affiliate creators — unusually strong, quantified creator evidence.

description: Leader in battery-powered outdoor power tools for DIY consumers, selling 24V to 82V cordless mowers, blowers, trimmers, chainsaws and snowblowers (100+ tools) through its own website and retail.

evidence.summary: Greenworks' own affiliates page says joining is free, commission runs 3%–6% across tiers that depend on the publisher's promotional model, the cookie window is 30 days and typical AOV is $330+; the signup link points to app.impact.com. Because the published figure is a tier range with the exact rate assigned privately after application, no single rate is recorded.

The same page inconsistently states that payouts are handled through the Rakuten network and that creative assets sit in a Rakuten portal, while its signup link goes to Impact — a self-contradicting source. The network is recorded as Impact (the actual application route) and the contradiction is flagged here; no cap statement appears, so commission_cap is unknown.

name: Greenworks

reasons.compensation: Published tiers of 3%–6% are low and the exact rate is only assigned privately after applying, so the recorded rate is null.
reasons.contact_access: Application runs through the brand's own affiliates page into Impact; no direct affiliate email is published.
reasons.credibility: Major established tool brand with a detailed first-party FAQ; held back only by the page's internal Rakuten/Impact inconsistency, which is documented in the evidence.
reasons.niche_fit: Outdoor power tools and yard gear are a solid home/garden creator niche, though less native to short-form UGC than indoor home tech.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free, open publisher signup with no stated follower minimum.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program recruits publishers and promoters with creative assets and seasonal campaigns, but publishes no creator-specific program or counts.
